messages:
Laura: Quick sync — onboarding SecureMesh (Andi) for KMS + SCIM + SSO ahead of Marketplace listing. Need certs, rotation plan, and final press timing. Draft timeline below. Partners: @Andi can you confirm PKCS#11 vs KMIP? Eng/security: quick read?
Miguel: Sounds good. From eng side we need HSM attestation, signer cert chain, and a latency matrix. Proposed phases: 1) SCIM + basic auth flow, 2) KMS integration with test keys, 3) SAML metadata exchange + E2E, 4) staging canary (Dedicated), 5) marketplace listing.
Miguel: Draft checklist:
```
- SCIM: attribute mapping, bulk sync test
- SAML: metadata + single logout test
- KMS: wrap/unwrap + key rotation test
- HSM: attestation & PKCS#11 validation
- Docs: integration guide + terraform sample
- Compliance: SOC2/Security signoff
```
Ops Bot: PART-4589 created for partner onboarding (links: /tickets/4589). Assigned: Miguel / Sara / Ankur / Evan.
Andi (Partner): We support PKCS#11 now; KMIP planned next quarter. Can share HSM attestation report and cert chain. SCIM supports PATCH + bulk import; we host SCIM at https://scim.securemesh.example.com. SAML metadata endpoint ready, will rotate cert every 90 days.
Sara: Security note: require SOC2 attestation + HSM firmware version in attestation. Need key wrapping algorithm list (please confirm RSA-OAEP and AES-GCM support). No external announcement until compliance signoff.
Ankur: DevEx: I will own the integration guide and sample Terraform module for the marketplace listing. Plan: draft in 2 weeks post-eng signoff, then internal review. Will stub a README in docs repo today.
Evan: Ops checklist: schedule Dedicated canary in us-west1 (10% traffic) with auto-fallback to hosted if error-rate > 1% or latency p50 > 300ms. Monitoring: add KMS RPC duration, KMS error-code heatmap, and SCIM sync lag. Add runbook for key rotation failures.
Laura: Great — can we lock embargo date? Proposing hold on public announcement until 2024-11-15 or until security signoff, whichever is later. Action items and owners: Andi -> attestation & cert chain by 2024-11-01; Miguel -> lead eng tests & latency matrix; Sara -> confirm algorithm list & compliance signoff by 2024-10-20; Ankur -> docs by 2024-11-05; Evan -> canary gating and dashboards by 2024-11-08. Ops Bot: please schedule reminder 2 days before embargo lift.
Ops Bot: Reminder scheduled for 1729999988 (placeholder timestamp for 2024-11-13).
Laura: :thumbsup: thanks all — I'll triage any blockers in the weekly partner sync.
Andi (Partner): Thanks — will upload attestation and sample PKCS#11 config to the shared drive by EOD next week.
Miguel: I'll ping when the staging cluster is ready for the first round of KMS E2E tests.
Sara: If we hit any compliance gaps we'll pause the canary; keep me looped.
Ankur: Uploading initial docs stub now: https://git.company/docs/securemesh-integration (draft).
Evan: Created dashboards and alerts; linking in PART-4589.
Laura: closing the thread for now, will follow up in partner sync on Tue.
